📏 UnitConvert

A quantity in one unit is shown — convert it to the target unit. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Identify the starting unit and target unit.
  2. Apply the correct conversion factor.
  3. Common conversions: meters↔feet, kg↔lb, liters↔gallons, °C↔°F.
  4. For °F: (°C × 9/5) + 32. For °C: (°F − 32) × 5/9.
  5. Check your calculation before submitting — one error and it's wrong.
